Title: Decide demo authentication mechanism
Description: ADR 0001 open question 1; the API currently has no auth/authz (KL-001, by design for this milestone). Choose simple seeded demo users vs a real identity provider. Source: docs/decisions/0001-architecture.md, docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Decide server evidence storage: local filesystem vs object storage
Description: ADR 0001 open question 2. Today files are written under backend/var/evidence behind the EvidenceStorage adapter (backend/app/storage.py). Decide whether object storage is required from the start. Source: docs/decisions/0001-architecture.md.

Title: Decide report persistence: stored permanently vs regenerated from immutable snapshot
Description: ADR 0001 open question 3. Reports are generated server-side from a reviewed snapshot; confirm whether the artifact is retained. Source: docs/decisions/0001-architecture.md.

Title: Decide max photo size and supported image formats
Description: ADR 0001 open question 4. Current default MAX_EVIDENCE_BYTES=10485760 and uploads require image/* content type. Confirm accepted limits/formats. Source: docs/decisions/0001-architecture.md, fieldproof-starter/README.md.

Title: Accept ADR 0001 (currently Status: Proposed)
Description: ADR 0001 is marked "Proposed; confirm during Milestone 1 review". Accepting it is required before the architecture can be considered locked. Source: docs/decisions/0001-architecture.md.

Title: Add server endpoint to set checklist outcomes and per-item notes
Description: KL-002: DONE 2026-10-13. PUT /api/v1/inspections/{id}/checklist/{item_id} sets PASS/FAIL/NOT_APPLICABLE + note with expected_version; Android queues CHECKLIST/UPDATE; submit requires terminal outcomes; report summary reflects synced outcomes. Source: docs/known-limitations.md, docs/api-contract.md.

Title: Add schema migrations (Alembic) instead of create_all
Description: KL-003: the schema is created with SQLAlchemy create_all; no migration path. Source: docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Add background/periodic automatic sync worker
Description: KL-004: sync triggers remain app-launch and manual retry. On-queue scheduling with a connected-network constraint is now implemented, but there is still no periodic worker, so evidence added while the app is open can wait for a relaunch/retry. Source: docs/known-limitations.md, docs/acceptance-criteria.md (line 22).

Title: Decide whether the PDF embeds raw photo bitmaps
Description: KL-005: the PDF references evidence (kind, id, note snippet) and reviewer sign-off but does not embed photo bitmaps. Confirm this stays an accepted limitation or becomes future work. Source: docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Verify and mark persistence acceptance criteria (offline, process death)
Description: acceptance-criteria.md items 1–2 ("Inspection and checklist changes persist after process termination while offline"; "Photos and notes persist locally and are linked to the correct checklist item") are unmarked. demo.md cites RoomPersistenceTest/OfflineToSyncIntegrationTest as coverage; confirm and check the boxes. Source: docs/acceptance-criteria.md.

Title: Reconcile permission-denial acceptance criterion
Description: acceptance-criteria.md item "Permission denial provides actionable feedback and does not corrupt local work" is unmarked; CameraPermissionDeviceTest and demo.md Steps 7–8 describe the behaviour. Confirm coverage and mark. Source: docs/acceptance-criteria.md.

Title: Verify reviewer sign-off references a specific inspection version
Description: acceptance-criteria.md item "Reviewer sign-off references a specific inspection version" is unmarked while the PDF criterion above it is satisfied. Confirm the versioned sign-off is present/tested. Source: docs/acceptance-criteria.md.

Title: Complete loading/empty/error/success states on primary flows
Description: acceptance-criteria.md item "Loading, empty, error, and success states are present on primary flows" is unmarked. Source: docs/acceptance-criteria.md.

Title: Provide Linear access so open decisions/blockers can be filed automatically
Description: BLOCKER: no Linear CLI, API key, or MCP integration exists in the working environment, so these rows cannot be pushed to Linear from here. Options: supply LINEAR_API_KEY + team, import this CSV via Linear's importer, or paste as issues. Source: environment check.

Title: Physical-device instrumentation on MIUI ROM is blocked
Description: KL-009: a MIUI device rejected instrumented-test installs/input injection (INSTALL_GRANT_RUNTIME_PERMISSIONS on gradle install). Workaround used: manual APK install + adb shell am instrument; CI API-34 emulator lane is the supported automated path. Source: docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Backend DB tests cannot run without PostgreSQL
Description: Without TEST_DATABASE_URL/DATABASE_URL the database-backed backend tests are skipped; there is no Postgres/Docker available in the local environment. Source: fieldproof-starter/README.md, docs/demo.md.

Title: Add production deployment/security baseline
Description: DONE 2026-10-13. Private S3-compatible object storage with SSE + lifecycle + public-access block (backend/app/storage.py); size-bounded streaming uploads, magic-byte MIME validation, malware-scan integration point (media.py, scanning.py); safe download headers + evidence download endpoint; externalized config; /readyz readiness; CORS allowlist; per-process rate limiting; non-root production Dockerfile + docker-compose.prod.yml + .env.example; docs/deployment.md and docs/disaster-recovery.md. Covered by tests/test_hardening.py. Source: docs/deployment.md.

Title: Scope S3 lifecycle expiry to eligible objects and stop clobbering bucket rules
Description: KL-028: DONE 2026-10-15. Expiration is tag-scoped to fieldproof-retention=eligible (only the APPROVED-only retention sweep tags objects; legal holds refused and skipped); app lifecycle is opt-in (EVIDENCE_S3_MANAGE_LIFECYCLE=false) and merges its own rules instead of replacing the bucket configuration. Covered by tests/test_hardening.py and tests/test_deletion_retention.py. Source: docs/known-limitations.md, docs/deployment.md.

Title: Authenticate tenant identity to replace X-Tenant-Id
Description: KL-015: tenancy is derived from an unauthenticated header and is not an authorization boundary. Replace with a verified identity claim once auth (KL-001) lands. Source: docs/known-limitations.md, docs/api-contract.md.

Title: Move rate limiting to a shared store / ingress
Description: KL-016: the in-process fixed-window limiter multiplies across replicas and resets on restart. Use Redis or an API gateway for multi-replica deployments. Source: docs/known-limitations.md, docs/deployment.md.

Title: Stream uploads directly into object storage
Description: KL-017: uploads are validated from bounded in-memory bytes rather than a streaming/multipart pass-through to S3. Bounded by MAX_EVIDENCE_BYTES. Source: docs/known-limitations.md, docs/deployment.md.

Title: Add evidence integrity/restore verification job
Description: KL-018: sha256 is stored per evidence row but there is no automated restore/checksum-verification job. See docs/disaster-recovery.md §4.2/§6. Source: docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Encrypt the Room database with SQLCipher
Description: KL-020: captured evidence files are encrypted with a Keystore-backed AES-256-GCM key, but the Room DB relies only on platform File-Based Encryption. Add SQLCipher (or field-level encryption) when the dependency is available. Source: docs/security.md, docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Schedule retention sweeps
Description: KL-022: retention is trigger-driven. Wire POST /api/v1/maintenance/retention to a cron/Job/EventBridge rule and run the Android local purge periodically, not only on app launch. Source: docs/security.md.

Title: Extend FLAG_SECURE to all evidence-bearing screens
Description: KL-023: screenshot protection currently covers only the detail and camera screens. Audit remaining screens and share affordances. Source: docs/security.md.

Title: Add signed release pipeline (AAB/APK, SBOM, provenance)
Description: DONE 2026-10-13. Gated .github/workflows/release.yml builds a versioned, signed AAB+APK via AWS KMS/Secrets Manager over GitHub OIDC, verifies the signature, archives mapping/SBOM/license report/checksums, attaches provenance, and publishes a GitHub Release. Keystore stays out of the repo (scripts/check_repo_hygiene.sh). Source: fieldproof-starter/docs/release.md.

Title: Add SBOM + license policy gate
Description: DONE 2026-10-13. scripts/generate_sbom.py (CycloneDX 1.5) and scripts/license_scan.py enforce scripts/license-policy.json (deny/unknown fail, documented overrides) over the release runtime classpath. Source: scripts/license-policy.json, fieldproof-starter/docs/release.md §6.

Title: Automate Play Console publishing and rollback
Description: KL-025: publishing is manual (upload, staged rollout, halt). Evaluate a Play Developer API / Google Play Publisher (GPP) integration or fastlane supply so releases and rollbacks are automated. Source: fieldproof-starter/docs/release.md §7.

Title: Automate upload-keystore rotation
Description: KL-027: signing uses a single shared upload keystore fetched at build time and rotation is a manual sequence (generate, Play upload-key reset, replace secret). Add a documented rotation runbook/tooling. Source: fieldproof-starter/docs/release.md §2.

Title: Fix checklist-outcome sync acknowledgement race
Description: KL-029: DONE 2026-10-15. Deterministic checklist:<itemId> operations are now acknowledged with a compare-and-set on a per-item localRevision (Room migration 3→4), inside a single Room transaction, so a slow in-flight upload can no longer mark a newer queued edit SYNCED. Covered by SyncRunnerTest (edit-mid-upload regression) and RoomPersistenceTest. Source: docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Never persist plaintext evidence when encryption fails
Description: KL-030: DONE 2026-10-15. EvidenceVault.import returns a typed EvidenceImportResult; InspectionRepository.addEvidence aborts on Failed instead of falling back to the plaintext URI, deletes the temp capture, and tells the user to retake. Covered by InspectionEvidenceLifecycleTest and EncryptedEvidenceVaultTest. Source: docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Block cleartext HTTP and inject the API base URL
Description: KL-031: DONE 2026-10-15. Base URL injected as BuildConfig.API_BASE_URL (FIELD_PROOF_API_BASE_URL / fieldproof.apiBaseUrl); manifest uses a network security config that denies cleartext in release and allows localhost cleartext in debug. Covered by NetworkConfigurationTest. Source: docs/known-limitations.md, docs/deployment.md.

Title: Harden the rate limiter keying and memory bounds
Description: KL-032: DONE 2026-10-15. Limiter keys on the client transport address (or a single trusted edge header) instead of the unverified X-Tenant-Id, evicts expired keys on a TTL, bounds key cardinality (RATE_LIMIT_MAX_KEYS), returns a stable Retry-After and exempts /metrics. Tenant is folded into the key only when RATE_LIMIT_TRUST_TENANT_HEADER is explicitly enabled. Covered by tests/test_hardening.py. Source: docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Make checklist-outcome sync idempotent on retry
Description: KL-033: DONE 2026-10-15. update_checklist_outcome now distinguishes an idempotent replay of an already-committed outcome (returns current item, no version bump, no false 409) from a genuinely different later edit on a stale version (still 409). Covered by tests/test_inspections.py. Source: docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Add structured logging, metrics and alerting hooks
Description: KL-034: DONE 2026-10-15. Single-line JSON logs with credential/note redaction and normalized paths, one http_request record plus X-Request-Id per request, and a GET /metrics Prometheus endpoint (optional X-Admin-Token) covering requests, latency, API errors, sync conflicts, rate-limit rejections, storage failures and migrations. Covered by tests/test_observability.py; runbook in docs/observability.md. Source: docs/known-limitations.md.

Title: Replace create_all with Alembic migrations
Description: KL-003: DONE 2026-10-15. Alembic manages the schema (initial migration + backend/alembic.ini + backend/migrations/); production compose runs a dedicated migrate service before api starts; CI validates an empty-DB upgrade and runs alembic check for drift; startup never mutates the production schema. Covered by tests/test_migrations.py. Source: docs/known-limitations.md, docs/deployment.md.
